'''Laura Sallés López''' (born 15 February 1986) is a practitioner of [[judo]] from Andorra. She has participated in several World Championships and has won several medals at the Games of Small States. Sallés participated in the [[2016 Summer Olympics]], serving as her country's flag bearer.<ref>{{cite news|title=Laura Sallés serà l'abanderada dels Jocs Olímpics a Rio|trans-title=Laura Sallés will be the flag bearer at the Rio Olympics|url=http://www.ara.ad/societat/Laura-Salles-Jocs-Olimpics-Rio_0_1621038078.html|language=ca|publisher=[[Ara (newspaper)|Ara]]|date=28 July 2016|accessdate=28 July 2016}}</ref> In the [[Judo at the 2016 Summer Olympics – Women's 63 kg|Women's 63 kg]], she lost to [[Katharina Haecker (judoka)|Katharina Haecker]] in the first round.
